title: Fin AI Support Chatbot Deployed by Anthropic Reportedly Prolonged a Canadian Engineering Firm's $3,500 Billing Dispute
summary: An executive at a Canadian engineering firm alleged that Anthropic's Fin AI support chatbot kept him in circular conversations for weeks while he sought a refund for a $3,500 duplicate Claude AI subscription charge. He later sought a chargeback; Anthropic reportedly canceled the working team account, disrupting work and requiring another subscription purchase. The report does not establish that AI caused the charge or cancellation.
